label: portable
method: Functional tests of real server.js/server/rooms.js/server/ws.js and real browser RoomClient using Node WebSocket. Temporary rooms and messages exist only in a new process bound to 127.0.0.1 on an OS-assigned port. No production host, existing server or real users are contacted. This is protocol/static-serving QA, not rendered UI, audio-device synchronization or load/performance benchmarking.

cases.name: worker, loader and original synthesis modules retain correct JavaScript MIME, contents and revalidation
sample caching and byte ranges preserve exact encoded audio bytes
create a public Hall room, host identity, seed and fresh room listing
joining the other venue returns the correct venue instead of changing rooms
a Hall guest joins with identical seed and member identity
host state and commands reach guests without changing the snapshot payload
the server rejects forged guest state, commands and host handoff
a late guest receives the complete playing snapshot and a full room rejects more members
clock ping echoes the timestamp and RoomClient maintains a finite server clock estimate
pose broadcast clamps coordinates, preserves seat zero and throttles duplicate updates
local chat is sanitized, echoed to its sender and rate limited
host handoff changes authorization and host departure restores the oldest member
RoomClient automatically rejoins after a local socket drop with preserved seed and snapshot
a private Sphere room stays out of the Hall room list and broadcasts remain isolated
empty rooms disappear and their codes cannot be rejoined

repositoryScope: Local candidate checkout; exact exercised source hashes are in sources.
curation: Full synthetic room/member/chat message logs and environment-specific repository path are omitted. All 15 named pass/fail results, source hashes, sample asset, isolated origin and server errors are retained.
